show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/6QhFP8
show.description: They mocked her, betrayed her, and threw her away as if she were nothing. But beneath the saree and silent smiles hides Surya Gayathri, a legendary Marine Commando whose name became a myth. When her past returns, the family that broke her discovers they have awakened a warrior they can never defeat.
